trust_decision.summary: The agent must not be able to make the process fetch private/internal addresses; the decision is made at the web_fetch boundary in nanobot/agent/tools/web.py by resolving the host and blocking private IPs, and by re-validating every redirect target before the next request is issued. At this pinned commit that protection is already complete on both web_fetch fetch paths, so the published diff adds no new check: it only converts the image preflight from a buffered client.get to a streamed request and closes the stream.

landing_point.why: The summary names the web_fetch tool; WebFetchTool.execute is its only public method and holds both the entry URL check and the image preflight hunk that the diff rewrites.

fix_sites.module_kind: internal helper added in the same tool module
internal helper, readability fallback, same module

O3_reason_to_dismiss: The image URL is taken from the configured image provider's HTTP response (providers/image_generation.py:760, :1220), not from the agent's URL argument; the advisory is about the web_fetch tool, the code sits in the providers package, and the generate_image tool is disabled by default (nanobot/agent/tools/image_generation.py:37).

O5_coupled_behaviour.what: The readability fallback consumes a fully buffered response (r.headers, r.text, r.content) and the preflight must not read the body of a non-image response; a blanket 'stream everything' fix breaks the fallback, which is exactly why the diff reads the body only for image/* (aread() at fix.diff:78, and the fix's test asserts a non-image body is never read at fix.diff:120-121).

O8_uncovered_routes.reason_to_dismiss: URL is provider-supplied infrastructure output rather than agent/user input, the code is in the providers package, and image_generation is disabled by default, so a solver can argue the web_fetch SSRF contract never covered it.
O8_uncovered_routes.distance: one file away in a different package (nanobot/providers vs nanobot/agent/tools)

O8b_injection_room.sibling: a second fetch mode inside the same tool (e.g. a direct/proxy fallback or a 'raw' mode) that calls client.get(url) with follow_redirects=True
O8b_injection_room.why_realistic: the tool already contains an unguarded raw client.get at web.py:558 next to the guarded helper at web.py:85, so a new mode or transport added by a maintainer would sit beside it and plausibly reuse it.

O8b_injection_room.sibling: a third streaming redirect-following downloader copied from the DingTalk media fetcher into a new tool or util module without the per-hop validate_url_target call
O8b_injection_room.why_realistic: the tree already carries two independent safe-redirect implementations (web.py:85-115 and dingtalk.py:362-434) and one deliberately unvalidated one (slack.py:472-476), so a maintainer writing a new downloader would copy the nearest one, and dropping the validation call is a natural partial copy.

O9_family: SSRF / unvalidated redirect target (CWE-918): outbound fetch that can be steered to loopback, RFC1918 or cloud-metadata addresses
